description: Owner admin panel + Pricing & Plans store + sidebar. Rewrite SubscriptionsPage.tsx into a 3-tab owner panel (Manage Plans / Purchase Requests / Purchase History) consuming usePackages + usePackageOrders (from FEAT-001) and update_package_order_status RPC, and rewrite FeatureStorePage.tsx into the 'Pricing and Plans' 6-plan store consuming usePackages. This FEAT clears the pre-existing build breakage (both pages currently import symbols that useModulePrices.ts no longer exports) and flips `npm run build` to GREEN. Also rename the AdminSidebar 'Feature Store' label to 'Pricing & Plans' (URL unchanged). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Rewrite src/pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage.tsx: KEEP the LoginForm env-var gate (read import.meta.env.VITE_SUB_ADMIN_EMAIL with fallback 'amenterprises1105@gmail.com' and VITE_SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback 'Ashu@1107'; store auth in sessionStorage 'sub_auth'), the AdminLayout wrapper, and useToast. REMOVE imports of updateModulePrice/ModulePrice/useModulePrices/prices and the old module-catalog UI. Import usePackages, upsertPackage, deletePackage, setPackageModules, setPackageFeatures, type Package from '@/hooks/usePackages'; usePackageOrders, approvePackageOrder, rejectPackageOrder, type PackageOrder from '@/hooks/usePackageOrders'; useSubscription for addActivePlan/unlockPackageModules. Build a SubscriptionDashboard with 3 Tabs.

SubscriptionsPage Tab 1 'Manage Plans': usePackages(); two sections 'Admin Plans' and 'Rider Plans', each rendering up to 3 plan cards plus an 'Add Plan' button. Each card edits name, description (Textarea), monthly price (Input number), one-time price (Input number), Popular (Switch), Enabled (Switch). 'Edit features' opens a Dialog with an ordered list to add/remove/edit feature bullets (string[]) -> setPackageFeatures(packageId, features). 'Edit modules' opens a Dialog with a Checkbox list of all module keys for that category (derive from MODULES filtered by group == category) -> setPackageModules(packageId, selected). Save calls upsertPackage then setPackageModules + setPackageFeatures then refetch. Include loading skeletons and empty states.

SubscriptionsPage Tab 2 'Purchase Requests': usePackageOrders(); render table/cards of all package_orders showing package name, category badge, buyer name/email/phone, billing type, amount, TRX ID, screenshot thumbnail (click opens the data URL), status badge, submitted date. Add search (name/email/order token) and filters (status, category). 30s auto-refresh is in the hook. For pending rows show Approve (green) + Reject (red) + remarks Input. Approve -> approvePackageOrder(id, remarks) then addActivePlan({planKey, category, billingType:'monthly'|'one_time', packageName, orderId}) / unlockPackageModules(planKey) from context, then refresh. Reject -> rejectPackageOrder(id, remarks). Render an inline status-history timeline under each order (map order.history).

SubscriptionsPage Tab 3 'Purchase History': full table of ALL package_orders sortable by date (default created_at desc): order token, package name, buyer, billing type, amount, status, subscription_start, subscription_end, created_at, updated_at. Active -> 'Running' badge with expiry (subscription_end) or 'Lifetime' for one_time; expired -> 'Expired' badge. Filter + search. Optional CSV export (build CSV string, download via Blob URL).

Rewrite src/pages/admin/FeatureStorePage.tsx: REMOVE imports of ModulePrice/useModulePrices/prices/MODULE_PRICES and the old module-card/CartDrawer UI. Import usePackages + Package from '@/hooks/usePackages' and useSubscription (hasActivePlan, activePlans, isModuleLocked). Page title 'Pricing and Plans'. Two sections 'Restaurant Admin' and 'Delivery Rider', each 3 plan cards from usePackages() filtered by category. Add a sticky GLOBAL billing toggle (Monthly / One-time) using shadcn Switch or Tabs that updates the displayed price on every card. Each card: name + tier badge ('Most Popular' if isPopular), description, price (monthlyPrice/mo or oneTimePrice), feature bullets (package features with lucide CheckCircle green icons), 'Includes N modules' count (moduleKeys.length). If the user has an active plan in this category (hasActivePlan(category) and activePlans), show 'Current Plan' badge and 'Upgrade' button (if a higher tier exists) instead of 'Buy'. 'Buy Now' writes sessionStorage['feature_store_cart'] = JSON.stringify({ planKey, packageName, category, billingType, amount }) where amount is the fetched package price for the selected billing type (never client-fabricated), then navigate('/checkout'). Disable Buy if the plan is already in cart or active. Responsive: 3-up grid desktop, stacked mobile; rounded cards, gradient accents, hover:scale. Loading skeletons, empty state.

Modify src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx: in managementItems change the entry { title: 'Feature Store', url: '/feature-store', icon: ShoppingBag } to title 'Pricing & Plans' (keep url '/feature-store' and the existing isModuleLocked lock-indicator logic). No other changes.
If needed, fix any import in src/App.tsx so FeatureStorePage/SubscriptionsPage default exports still resolve after the rewrites (likely no change — same default-exported components).
acceptance_criteria: SubscriptionsPage.tsx no longer imports updateModulePrice, ModulePrice, useModulePrices, or prices; it imports from usePackages and usePackageOrders and renders 3 tabs (Manage Plans, Purchase Requests, Purchase History) with the env-var LoginForm gate preserved (reading VITE_SUB_ADMIN_EMAIL/VITE_SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD with fallbacks)

FeatureStorePage.tsx no longer imports ModulePrice/useModulePrices/prices/MODULE_PRICES; it imports usePackages and renders the 'Pricing and Plans' 6-plan store with a global Monthly/One-time billing toggle, feature bullets, Includes-N-modules count, Current Plan/Upgrade/Buy logic, and cart write-through to /checkout
AdminSidebar shows the label 'Pricing & Plans' and still links to /feature-store
`npm run build` exits 0 (this is the stage where the build flips GREEN)
verification: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\JalipEmpire\Downloads\pizza-king-main — must exit 0 with zero Rollup errors. This is the primary gate; it confirms both build-breaking files are fixed.
Run `npm run lint` and fix any new lint errors in SubscriptionsPage.tsx, FeatureStorePage.tsx, AdminSidebar.tsx.

Run `npm run dev` and manually confirm: /subscriptions shows the env-var login then the 3-tab dashboard; /feature-store shows 'Pricing and Plans' with 6 plan cards and the billing toggle; the sidebar shows 'Pricing & Plans'.
findings: Build GREEN (npm run build exit 0, 'built in 1m 11s'), lint clean for all 3 changed files. Changed: src/pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage.tsx (3-tab owner panel: Manage Plans / Purchase Requests / Purchase History; env-var LoginForm gate preserved reading VITE_SUB_ADMIN_EMAIL fallback amenterprises1105@gmail.com and VITE_SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback Ashu@1107, sessionStorage 'sub_auth'; AdminLayout + useToast kept; consumes usePackages + upsertPackage/deletePackage/setPackageModules/setPackageFeatures + usePackageOrders + approvePackageOrder/rejectPackageOrder + useSubscription.addActivePlan/unlockPackageModules; zero useModulePrices imports), src/pages/admin/FeatureStorePage.tsx ('Pricing and Plans' 6-plan store; global Monthly/One-time Tabs toggle; green CheckCircle feature bullets; Includes-N-modules count; Current Plan/Upgrade/Buy logic; cart write-through to /checkout with amount = fetched package price), src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx (label 'Feature Store' -> 'Pricing & Plans', url /feature-store unchanged, isModuleLocked lock indicator kept). NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: (1) useModulePrices.ts STILL exports ModulePrice/updateModulePrice/useModulePrices — the plan's premise that the build was RED was outdated; FEAT-002 removed the last two consumers, leaving useModulePrices.ts as harmless legacy with no external consumers (matches context.json). Build was green before AND after. (2) Cart shape in sessionStorage 'feature_store_cart' is a single plan {planKey, packageName, category, billingType:'monthly'|'one_time', amount} — CheckoutPage (FEAT-004) must read this shape and RE-FETCH the package price via usePackages server-side, never trusting the cart amount field. (3) Approval unlock relies on SubscriptionContext.unlockPackageModules(planKey) which reads PLAN_MODULES — this only covers the 6 seeded plan_keys, so admin-defined custom plans added via 'Add Plan' store modules in DB package_modules but will NOT unlock modules client-side on approval (known limitation, out of FEAT-002 scope). (4) SubscriptionsPage route in App.tsx is /admin/subscriptions (not /subscriptions). (5) usePackageOrders auto-polls every 30s; usePackages only refetches on explicit refetch() after a save. (6) Manage Plans uses usePackages() which fetches is_enabled=true only, so disabling a plan removes it from the manage list on next refetch (expected; re-enable via Add Plan with same plan_key).
